findings.title: Validate producer quote timestamps after the async producer returns
findings.trigger: quote() samples clockNow(now) at line 267 before quoteFor awaits quoteRecipe. A producer returning a valid quote with createdAt sampled after async work naturally has createdAt greater than that earlier sample.
findings.actual: quoteFor rejects it as STALE_REVISION before insertion, even with matching full inputHash and future expiry.
findings.expected: Sample the trusted clock after await for future-created/expiry checks, and retain a fresh commit-time check. The locally generated unknown quote can keep its own creation sample.
findings.required_evidence: One focused injected async producer quote with creation time after call start succeeds; genuinely future-created and commit-expired quote remains rejected without writes.
findings.verification: Source-derived finding; the existing minimal fixture has no injected quoteRecipe producer case.

findings.title: Retain and compare exact eligibility context across byte verification
findings.trigger: buildRecipe checks productionSubmissionEligibilityFingerprint only for nonnull; quote/enqueue compare recipe hashes after await. A same-time valid approved anchor decision set may grow while preserving the requested approval ID.
findings.actual: The helper fingerprint changes because anchorApprovalIds changes, but the recipe only stores the requested anchorApprovalId; recipe hash remains equal and append succeeds.
findings.expected: Capture initial eligibility fingerprint from the existing helper using the stable ephemeral snapshot/job, then recompute and require exact equality in TX before quote/job append, alongside existing recipe/media hash checks.
findings.required_evidence: One bounded async verification drift fixture changes exact relevant approval context without invalidating eligibility; returns STALE_REVISION and persists no quote/job/outbox.
findings.verification: Source-derived contract finding. Normal story/plan/animatic successor drift does change current recipe pins and is already compared.
